Company or product information: Please provide a detailed brief about your company, product or service. There is no word limit, so the more information you can provide, the better.

URL links: Please provide any website or relevant URL links you would like to be included within the article.

To help us prepare your enewsletter section, please provide the following:

Copy: 80–120 words of promotional copy.

Campaign brief: A brief overview of what you are looking to achieve with the placement, such as raising awareness of a specific offer, product or service.

Image: One high-resolution image to accompany your copy.

Logo & URL: Your company logo and the click-through URL you would like to use.

Test recipients: A list of email addresses you would like us to include when sending the test email for approval.

digitalSpecs.name: Social Amplification
digitalSpecs.spec:
To help us prepare your sponsored social post, please provide the following:

Image: One high-resolution image, ideally 720px W × 960px H.

Copy: A short, concise piece of copy to accompany the image. We recommend using as few words as possible while clearly communicating your key message.

Click-through URL: The URL you would like users to be directed to, such as an advertorial or product landing page.

Targeting: Any specific audience or targeting requirements you would like us to consider.

Social tag: Your social media handle/tag so that we can tag your company or brand in the post.
